sections.title: Practicum in Implementation Science
sections.description: This course offers an opportunity for trainees to apply competencies in implementation research and practice. Through mentorship from course directors, trainees will receive guidance as they execute individual projects. Prerequisite: IMP 6000, HPR 6110, or HPR 6200
